body.en: The first census was conducted in 1881. Before 1921 India was in the first stage of demographic transition; the second stage began after 1921, so 1921 is called the year of the great divide. Overall literacy was below 16 per cent, female literacy about 7 per cent, infant mortality about 218 per thousand and life expectancy about 32 years.

title.en: On the board: India in 1947: people and work

say.en: Look at the demographic figures on the eve of independence.
The first census came in 1881. 1921 is the year of the great divide.
About 70 to 75 per cent worked in agriculture, 10 in manufacturing, 15 to 20 in services.
Railways from 1850 served colonial needs: raw materials to ports, troops across India.

body.en: Occupational structure is the distribution of the workforce across sectors. Agriculture was the largest occupation with 70–75 per cent of the workforce, manufacturing had about 10 per cent and services 15–20 per cent. Regional variation grew: parts of Madras Presidency, Bombay and Bengal saw agriculture's share fall, while Orissa, Rajasthan and Punjab saw it rise.
body.kn: ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ರಚನೆ ಎಂದರೆ ವಿವಿಧ ವಲಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ದುಡಿಮೆಗಾರರ ಹಂಚಿಕೆ. ಕೃಷಿಯಲ್ಲಿ 70–75%, ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಮಾರು 10%, ಸೇವೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 15–20% ದುಡಿಮೆಗಾರರಿದ್ದರು.

Agriculture was the largest occupation with 70–75 per cent of the workforce, manufacturing had about 10 per cent and services 15–20 per cent. Regional variation grew: parts of Madras Presidency, Bombay and Bengal saw agriculture's share fall, while Orissa, Rajasthan and Punjab saw it rise.

body.en: Railways, ports, water transport, posts and telegraphs were developed, but to serve colonial interests: to move raw materials to ports and troops across the country. Railways, introduced in 1850, let people travel long distances, broke geographical and cultural barriers and helped commercialise agriculture, but the social cost was high and Indians gained little. Roads were poor, inland waterways such as the Coast Canal in Orissa proved uneconomical, and the electric telegraph mainly helped maintain law and order.
body.kn: ರೈಲು, ಬಂದರು, ಜಲಸಾರಿಗೆ, ಅಂಚೆ ಮತ್ತು ತಂತಿ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಬೆಳೆದರೂ ಅವು ವಸಾಹತುಶಾಹಿ ಹಿತಕ್ಕಾಗಿ. 1850ರಲ್ಲಿ ಆರಂಭವಾದ ರೈಲ್ವೆ ದೂರ ಪ್ರಯಾಣ ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗಿಸಿ ಕೃಷಿಯ ವಾಣಿಜ್ಯೀಕರಣಕ್ಕೆ ನೆರವಾಯಿತು.
